tooltip.essentialcraft5.inquisitorium_he.en: Lenses forged from moonlight metal to see impurity
tooltip.essentialcraft5.inquisitorium_he.zh: 以月光金属磨成的镜片，能看穿一切不洁

tooltip.essentialcraft5.inquisitorium_le.en: Magic is a parasite. It must be wiped out!
tooltip.essentialcraft5.inquisitorium_le.zh: 魔法是寄生虫，必须根除！

tooltip.essentialcraft5.glitchy_core.usa.en: Decode it in a Radiating Chamber fed MRU of this balance
tooltip.essentialcraft5.glitchy_core.usa.zh: 放进辐射仓，接入这个平衡值的 MRU 来解码

tooltip.essentialcraft5.inquisitorium_co.en: Hold it in Hoanna to see the direction and distance
tooltip.essentialcraft5.inquisitorium_co.zh: 在海纳尔拿在手里，会指出方向和距离
空白：上面没有解出来的坐标

tooltip.essentialcraft5.inquisitorium_ch.en: Dropped by the Inquisitorium Sentinel; used for Blank Modules and Inquisitorium armor
tooltip.essentialcraft5.inquisitorium_ch.zh: 审判庭哨兵留下的；做空白模块和审判庭套装用

tooltip.essentialcraft5.inquisitorium_be.en: Place it near these coordinates under open sky and right-click at night
tooltip.essentialcraft5.inquisitorium_be.zh: 放在这处坐标附近的露天处，夜里右键

tooltip.essentialcraft5.inquisitorium_be.en: Remembers no coordinates: it answers nothing
tooltip.essentialcraft5.inquisitorium_be.zh: 没有记着坐标：什么都不会回应

message.essentialcraft5.inquisitorium_be.en: Only a player in survival or adventure mode can light the beacon
message.essentialcraft5.inquisitorium_be.zh: 只有生存或冒险模式的玩家能点亮审判庭信标

message.essentialcraft5.inquisitorium_be.en: Nothing answers the beacon on Peaceful difficulty
message.essentialcraft5.inquisitorium_be.zh: 和平难度下，信标没有回应

message.essentialcraft5.inquisitorium_be.en: The beacon only works in Hoanna
message.essentialcraft5.inquisitorium_be.zh: 审判庭信标只能在海纳尔点亮
这个信标没有记着坐标

message.essentialcraft5.inquisitorium_be.en: The beacon must be within %s blocks of its coordinates (now %s)
message.essentialcraft5.inquisitorium_be.zh: 信标要放在它记着的坐标 %s 格以内（现在离 %s 格）

message.essentialcraft5.inquisitorium_be.en: The beacon needs open sky above it
The echo only answers at night, or in Hoanna's darkness
message.essentialcraft5.inquisitorium_be.zh: 回声只在夜里、或海纳尔的黑暗天灾中回应

message.essentialcraft5.inquisitorium_be.en: There is no room 5 blocks above the beacon
message.essentialcraft5.inquisitorium_be.zh: 信标上方 5 格的地方被挡住了

message.essentialcraft5.inquisitorium_be.en: Another Holographic Projection or Sentinel is within 64 blocks
message.essentialcraft5.inquisitorium_be.zh: 64 格内已经有一个全息投影或审判庭哨兵了

message.essentialcraft5.inquisitorium_be.en: You may not use this beacon here
message.essentialcraft5.inquisitorium_be.zh: 你没有权限在这里点亮信标
